Because of that, I had to dress up in a highly formal matching jacket and trousers set with a silk neckpiece, which is a total one-off from my typical comfortable hooded sweatshirt and fleece lounge pants!

turns.text: That's a great way to stay in the zone. I hope the presentation went exceptionally well! By the way, speaking of things happening around town, did you hear that a new indoor climbing facility just opened up on the other side of Minneapolis?

turns.text: I did hear about that new climbing gym opening across town! I'm definitely intrigued, especially now that my fractured wrist is completely healed and I'm back to my usual activities.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It might be worth checking out once you have a free weekend! Since you had such a busy, high-stakes day today, how are you and Leah planning to celebrate tonight?

turns.text: We're treating ourselves to a special dinner at home. I'm going to sear a couple of thick, premium cuts of beef in a hot pan tonight.

turns.text: A beautifully seared cut of beef sounds like the absolute perfect reward after a successful presentation. Do you have any relaxed plans for tomorrow, perhaps getting out with your camera or on your bike?
